# Agent Desk

> Zero-dependency localhost web dashboard over Agent Lanes task files. Shows each coding task's allowed scope, changed and out-of-scope Git paths, notes, and a copyable handoff. Binds to 127.0.0.1 only; writes are limited to task metadata and can be disabled with `--read-only`.

Requires Node.js 24.8+ and Git. No accounts, telemetry, or model API calls.

## Run

- `npx --yes @hexmillionaire/agent-desk --demo`: labeled sample data, read-only
- `agent-desk --repo /absolute/path/to/project [--repo ...]`: open http://127.0.0.1:4317
- `agent-desk --config desk.json`: `{"repositories":[{"name":"My project","path":"/absolute/path"}]}`
- Options: `--port <n>`, `--read-only`, `--version`, `--help`

Tasks are created with the `agent-lanes` CLI or the dashboard's "New task" form. Agents should use the CLI or the read-only MCP server rather than this HTTP API.
